name: Learning well from limited or offline data
gist: Training agents effectively using only recorded data without interaction, or learning efficiently from a small amount of experience, which is crucial when real-world trials are expensive.
explain: Normally, reinforcement learning is active: the agent tries actions, sees outcomes, and tries more. But sometimes you can't interact. Medical treatments have to be chosen carefully — you can't run many trials on a patient. Robots might learn from videos of human workers, without being able to recreate those exact situations. Data is expensive or dangerous. Offline reinforcement learning asks: how can you learn from only recorded data, without real-time interaction?

The trap is that the recorded data reflects old decisions: whoever collected it chose certain actions and avoided others, so the learner has limited coverage. A new action the agent wants to try might be completely absent from the data. The learner can't directly observe what happens if you do that action. Papers here use techniques like conservative learning — the agent sticks close to actions that appear in the data and avoids wild extrapolation — or data augmentation, where the agent learns a model and simulates new scenarios. Some papers also address batch reinforcement learning, where the agent gets a fixed batch of data and must get the best policy it can.
This is essential for domains where trial-and-error is too expensive: medical therapy planning, autonomous vehicle safety testing, robotic surgery, and learning from human demonstrations.

papers.title: Chunking the Critic: A Transformer-based Soft Actor-Critic with N-Step Returns
papers.contribution: The sequence-aware critic consistently outperforms standard SAC and strong baselines with large gains on long-trajectory control despite its simplicity.

papers.title: DEAS: DEtached value learning with Action Sequence for Scalable Offline RL
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms baselines on complex long-horizon OGBench tasks and can enhance vision-language-action models, boosting performance on RoboCasa and real-world manipulation.

papers.title: Dual Goal Representations
papers.contribution: Dual representations consistently improve offline goal-reaching performance across 20 OGBench tasks.

papers.title: Less Is More: Clustered Cross-Covariance Control for Offline RL
papers.contribution: The method achieves up to 30% improvement in returns over prior methods, especially with small datasets and splits emphasizing out-of-distribution areas, while preserving lower bound properties of maximization objectives.

papers.title: Model-based Offline RL via Robust Value-Aware Model Learning with Implicitly Differentiable Adaptive Weighting
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms RAMBO on D4RL and NeoRL datasets, achieving competitive performance through controllable conservatism and stable model updates.

papers.title: Peak-Return Greedy Slicing: Subtrajectory Selection for Transformer-based Offline RL
papers.contribution: PRGS significantly improves Transformer-based offline RL performance across benchmark datasets by effectively leveraging valuable subtrajectories.

papers.title: SAC Flow: Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning of Flow-Based Policies via Velocity-Reparameterized Sequential Modeling
papers.contribution: SAC Flow achieves state-of-the-art performance on continuous control and robotic manipulation benchmarks while eliminating the need for policy distillation or surrogate objectives.

papers.title: Transitive RL: Value Learning via Divide and Conquer
papers.contribution: Achieves best performance in challenging long-horizon benchmark tasks compared to temporal difference and Monte Carlo methods by reducing bias accumulation to O(log T) instead of O(T).

papers.title: $\text{DT}^\text{2}$: Decision-Targeted Digital Twins
papers.contribution: Consistently improves policy ranking and reduces decision regret compared to conventional DT training across diverse settings and architectures.

papers.title: Accelerating Diffusion Planners in Offline RL via Reward-Aware Consistency Trajectory Distillation
papers.contribution: Achieves 9.7% improvement over state-of-the-art and 142x speedup over diffusion models in inference time.

papers.title: Action-Free Offline-To-Online RL via Discretised State Policies
papers.contribution: Improves convergence speed and asymptotic performance on diverse benchmarks while learning from datasets lacking actions, establishing a scalable framework for action-free offline RL.

papers.title: AdamO: A Collapse-Suppressed Optimizer for Offline RL
papers.contribution: Theoretically guarantees worst-case task safety while preserving Adam's dissipative dynamics; plug-and-play across offline RL baselines with improved stability and returns.

papers.title: Adaptive Scaling of Policy Constraints for Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Using a single hyperparameter configuration outperforms other adaptive methods and per-dataset-tuned algorithms, achieving 35% average improvement in normalized performance.

papers.title: Belief-Based Offline Reinforcement Learning for Delay-Robust Policy Optimization
papers.contribution: DT-CORL achieves strong delay-robust generalization across D4RL benchmarks without requiring delayed transitions during training.

papers.title: BiTrajDiff: Bidirectional Trajectory Generation with Diffusion Models for Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms advanced data augmentation methods across offline RL backbones by recovering global trajectory-level connectivity.

papers.title: Causal Flow Q-Learning for Robust Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Proposes a confounding-robust offline RL method that achieves 120% of the success rate of state-of-the-art confounding-unaware methods on 25 pixel-based tasks.

papers.title: Chunk-Guided Q-Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves tighter critic optimality bounds than single-step or action-chunked TD alone, with strong performance on long-horizon OGBench tasks.

papers.title: Continuity-Regularized Flow Matching for Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on challenging offline RL tasks by structuring the entire probability flow, balancing imitation and smoothness.

papers.title: Cross-Embodiment Offline Reinforcement Learning for Heterogeneous Robot Datasets
papers.contribution: Excels at pre-training with suboptimal data; grouping strategy outperforms existing conflict-resolution methods on 16 robot platforms.

papers.title: DRIVE: Distributional and Retrieval-Augmented Bidding with Value Evaluation
papers.contribution: Consistently improves bidding performance across AuctionNet and reinforcement learning benchmarks with good generalization.

papers.title: Debiased Model-based Representations for Sample-efficient Continuous Control
papers.contribution: DR.Q matches or surpasses recent strong baselines on numerous continuous control benchmarks with a single set of hyperparameters, sometimes by large margins.

papers.title: Decoupled Q-Chunking
papers.contribution: Retains multi-step value benefits while avoiding open-loop sub-optimality on long-horizon offline goal-conditioned benchmarks.

papers.title: Discounted Beta–Bernoulli Reward Estimation for Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
papers.contribution: DBB consistently outperforms naive GRPO across six in-distribution and three out-of-distribution reasoning benchmarks, with average improvements of 3.43/2.32 points in-distribution.

papers.title: Expected Returns and Policy Inconsistency-Aware Offline Federated Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: The framework improves offline FDRL performance by considering both Q-values and policy inconsistency for adaptive client weighting during global aggregation.

papers.title: Fast Mixing Steady-State Control in Markov Decision Processes
papers.contribution: The work provides a tractable convex formulation for FMSS and an offline sample-based algorithm (FMSS-SV) with finite-sample complexity analysis for tabular MDPs.

papers.title: Flow Actor-Critic for Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: The method achieves new state-of-the-art performance on D4RL and OGBench offline RL benchmarks.

papers.title: GAS: Enhancing Reward-Cost Balance of Generative Model-assisted Offline Safe RL
papers.contribution: Enhances stitching capabilities and accommodates a broader range of reward-cost return pairs for better tradeoff between reward maximization and constraint satisfaction.

papers.title: HTAC: Hierarchical Task-Aware Composition for Continual Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: HTAC outperforms baselines on Offline Continual World, demonstrating better knowledge reuse and transfer capabilities.

papers.title: Improving Zero-Shot Offline RL via Behavioral Task Sampling
papers.contribution: Improves zero-shot performance by average of 20% across benchmarks and baselines.

papers.title: InfraRL: A Benchmark for Constrained Resource Allocation in Large-Scale Infrastructure Asset Management
papers.contribution: Benchmarks diverse approaches revealing critical trade-offs between safety and long-term efficiency.

papers.title: MAGE: Multi-scale Autoregressive Generation for Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: MAGE effectively integrates multi-scale trajectory modeling with conditional guidance, generating coherent and controllable trajectories in long-horizon sparse-reward settings.

papers.title: Offline Reinforcement Learning of High-Quality Behaviors Under Robust Style Alignment
papers.contribution: Achieves superior performance on both task performance and style alignment compared to prior offline methods.

papers.title: Offline Reinforcement Learning with Adaptive Feature Fusion
papers.contribution: Outperforms current methods on D4RL benchmarks, establishing new state-of-the-art performance with improved generalization across different tasks without extensive hyperparameter tuning.

papers.title: Offline Reinforcement Learning with Generative Trajectory Policies
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art on D4RL benchmarks including perfect scores on hard AntMaze tasks, outperforming prior generative policies.

papers.title: Offline Two-Player Zero-Sum Markov Games with KL Regularization
papers.contribution: SOS-MD achieves a fast Õ(1/n) convergence rate with unilateral concentrability, improving over standard Õ(1/√n) rates in unregularized settings.

papers.title: Peng's Q($\lambda$) for Conservative Value Estimation in Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: CPQL consistently and significantly outperforms existing offline single-step baselines on D4RL benchmark.

papers.title: Population-Free Pareto Tracking for Sample-Efficient Multi-Policy MORL
papers.contribution: Outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in hypervolume and expected utility across six robotic control tasks and high-dimensional tasks, significantly reducing interactions.

papers.title: Q-SAM: Unlocking Sharpness-Aware Minimization for Generalization in Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Consistently improve generalization performance across diverse datasets and algorithms while preserving training stability in offline RL.

papers.title: ReFORM: Reflected Flows for On-support Offline RL via Noise Manipulation
papers.contribution: Dominates all baselines on 40 OGBench tasks with constant hyperparameters, maintaining strong performance across datasets of varying quality.

papers.title: Recurrent Action Transformer with Memory
papers.contribution: Significantly improves performance in memory-dependent settings while remaining competitive on standard tasks across broad range of baselines.

papers.title: Test-time Offline Reinforcement Learning on Goal-related Experience
papers.contribution: Achieves significant performance gains across high-dimensional navigation and manipulation tasks at modest compute costs, with scaling benefits comparable to increasing model size.

papers.title: Toward Conservative Planning from Preferences in Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: First provably sample-efficient and computationally tractable offline preference-based RL algorithm under partial data coverage.

papers.title: Towards Efficient and Expressive Offline RL via Flow-Anchored Noise-conditioned Q-Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance while significantly reducing training and inference runtimes on robotic manipulation and locomotion tasks.

papers.title: Trajectory Generation with Conservative Value Guidance for Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: TGCVG improves state-of-the-art offline RL performance while significantly reducing training and trajectory synthesis time.

papers.title: Trajectory-Level Data Augmentation for Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Enables training from limited suboptimal trajectories with theoretical justification and validated performance across positioning tasks under partial observability.

papers.title: Unifying Value Alignment and Assignment in Cross-Domain Offline Reinforcement Learning with Heterogeneous Datasets
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms baselines under general heterogeneous cross-domain offline RL settings.

papers.title: VIPO: Value Function Inconsistency Penalized Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: VIPO achieves state-of-the-art performance on almost all D4RL and NeoRL benchmarks and provides a general framework integrable into existing model-based offline RL algorithms.

papers.title: Zero-Shot Off-Policy Learning
papers.contribution: Enables fast-adaptation to new tasks in training-free regime on motion tracking, continuous control, and long-horizon tasks with performance comparable to model-free and model-based methods.
